business_problem: LDS needed to reduce the time, cost and risk involved in manual patent searches and drafting work so its attorneys could protect clients' intellectual property more efficiently without sacrificing accuracy or data security.
solution_summary: LDS worked with IBM and partner nFlo to adopt PatentPro AI, a solution built on IBM watsonx.ai for patent-search and drafting workflows. Attorneys can now describe inventions in natural language instead of manually querying and reviewing large patent datasets, and PatentPro AI uses API integrations to surface relevant patents with confidence scores. Because the firm handles commercially sensitive client information, the solution was also designed with strong information-security and data-governance controls rather than treating generative AI as an isolated experiment. The same platform is being extended beyond search into drafting support, where shorter attorney inputs can be expanded into fuller application drafts for human review. This makes watsonx.ai the reasoning layer for both retrieval and content creation, giving LDS a practical AI tool that shortens research-heavy legal work while keeping professionals in control of final filings.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Powers PatentPro AI for natural-language patent search, confidence-scored retrieval and draft-generation support.

data_flow: Attorneys describe inventions in natural language, PatentPro AI queries patent sources through API integrations, watsonx.ai returns ranked patent results with confidence scores, and the same platform can expand shorter attorney inputs into draft applications for review.
business_outcome: LDS reduced time spent on manual IP work, improved confidence in search results, and created a path to handle more matters while keeping attorneys focused on higher-value strategic and technical work.
